My Family Vision

Discipline builds
the life.

Discipline creates the space. Awareness brings me into the moment. Participation makes it my life.

I participate in my life.
I show up fully for what is here.
I take responsibility without waiting to be reminded.
I finish what I commit to.
My family receives my presence, not my leftovers.
Our family vision

A family that is awake to life.

Our home is a place where Nandini, Leela and I feel seen, heard, respected and loved.

We choose connection over distraction, understanding over winning, and repair over prolonged conflict.

We don't just live under the same roof. We experience life together. We go outside, play, travel, learn, laugh, create and make memories together.

Nandini and I are partners. We protect our friendship, affection and intimacy. We share responsibility and make decisions together.

I stay connected to Leela's world. I listen, play, learn and create with her. I guide her through presence and example, not only advice.

We care for our bodies, minds and spiritual lives. We know our finances, live within our means, invest consistently and use money to support life rather than making wealth the purpose of life.

Discipline over intensity. Consistency over excitement. Action over intention. Presence over productivity. Relationships over projects.

This ordinary day is our life.
Daily rhythm

The day

5:00–7:00

SELF

Spirituality, movement, reflection, reading, shower and grounding.

7:00–8:00

HOUSE

Morning responsibilities, preparation and helping without being asked.

8:00–4:00

WORK

Deep work, meetings, collaboration and lunch. Finish work here.

4:00–5:30

HOUSE

Cooking, cleaning, groceries, finances, errands and life admin.

5:30–10:00

FAMILY

Leela, outdoors, play, dinner, Nandini, affection and shared life.

10:00–5:00

SELF / SLEEP

Sleep, recovery and preparation for another consistent day.

Weekly rhythm

Three spaces we make for life

💰

Finance Date

Friday · 8:30–9:00 PM

Review spending, upcoming expenses, savings and investments, and make financial decisions together. End by asking: “Are we okay financially this week?”

❤️

Us Date

Saturday · 9:00–10:00 PM

Protected couple time. No finances, chores, parenting problems or phones. Make space for conversation, affection, friendship and closeness without forcing an outcome.

🌲

Family Outdoor Day

Sunday · 10:00 AM–2:00 PM

Leave the house together. Lake, walk, hike, cycling, swimming, picnic, café, museum, day trip or another shared experience that creates memories.

Every week we invest in our security, our relationship and our memories.

A good family life does not happen in the time left over. We put it on the calendar.

My daily commitments

How I return to awareness

I am here.

My family doesn't receive what's left of me. They receive some of the best of me.

I keep my word.

When I say I will do something, I do it. Small promises kept repeatedly build trust.

I regulate before I react.

I don't need to win an argument. I listen, understand and respond with maturity.

I am Nandini's partner.

I notice her, appreciate her, share the load, initiate connection and protect our friendship and intimacy.

I am connected to Leela.

I enter her world instead of always trying to direct it. I play, listen, explore and learn with her.

I participate instead of watching.

We walk. We play. We explore. We travel. We experience the world together.

I finish before I start.

Every interesting idea does not deserve a project.

I use discipline to protect what matters.

I don't wait until I feel like doing what matters.

I return through repetition.

One workout. One conversation. One walk. One date. One promise. One day at a time.

The boundary
5:30 PM: step into life.

Before 5:30: “What do I need to accomplish?”

After 5:30: “How do I participate in our life?”
